podcasts.name: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Contemporary Concept Album Artists
podcast.body: 30 Seconds to Mars is mentioned as one of the contemporary acts currently releasing concept albums. "Hello again, I'm Ellie Cross and with all the concept albums that we're seeing these days, Nine Inch Nails, My Chemical Romance, Coheating Cambria, The Arcade Fire, 30 Seconds to Mars, 30 Seconds to Mars, I thought it might be cool if we went back through the history of Alt Rock to see where all this came from."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Goth Leanings
podcast.body: This band, categorized as "emo-ish," emphasizes Goth leanings, particularly through their visual style. "Some emo-ish bands emphasize their Goth leanings, especially with their look. Check out 30 seconds to Mars or my chemical romance."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Leading Emo Band
podcast.body: 30 Seconds to Mars was among the bands that saw their rise during the Emo trend in the 2000s. Their inclusion in a list of prominent Emo and Emo-ish bands highlights their contribution to the genre's significant, though short-lived, impact on the alt-rock scene. "Dashboard, confessional, taking back Sunday, panic at the disco, followed boy, story of the year, funeral for a friend, 30 seconds to Mars."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Unexpected Warped Tour Resume Entry
podcast.body: Thirty Seconds to Mars is included among the artists whose Warped Tour participation might be an unexpected discovery on their career resume. "Here are some other artists that you may not have expected to have warped on their resume... 30 Seconds to Mars..."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
